events.text: Carlos Sainz Jr. was born.
Sainz raced in the British and European Formula 3 championships for Carlin.
Sainz raced for DAMS in the Formula Renault 3.5 season and won the championship.
Sainz moved to McLaren and ended his contract with Red Bull Racing.
Sainz finished second at Monza.
Sainz departed for Ferrari at the end of the season.
Sainz scored his third podium by finishing second at the Monaco Grand Prix.
Sainz won the Asia-Pacific KF3 title.
Sainz finished runner-up in the Spanish Championship.
Sainz won the Junior Monaco Kart Cup.
Sainz was runner-up in the European KF3 Championship.
Sainz raced in Formula BMW Europe with the EuroInternational team.
Sainz finished the Formula BMW Europe season 4th with 227 points.
Sainz raced in both British and Euro Series Formula 3 championships.
Sainz finished sixth overall in the British Formula 3 championship standings.
Sainz finished in ninth position overall in the Euro Series championship.
Sainz signed with Arden to compete in the GP3 series.
Sainz raced in Formula Renault 3.5 for the first time.
Sainz retired in race 1 and scored 6th place in the last race weekend of the year in Catalunya.
Sainz switched teams to DAMS.
Sainz finished 18th in the first race and won the second race at the season opener at Monza.
Sainz won at Aragon and finished 4th in race 2.
Sainz finished in 4th place at the one race in Monaco.
Sainz achieved two wins at the weekend at Spa.
Sainz finished 14th and 6th at Moscow.
Sainz won race 1 and retired in race 2 at the Nurburgring Gp Circuit.
Sainz finished in 6th place in race 2 in Hungary.
Sainz won in France and scored 50 points to extend his championship lead.
Sainz was announced as a test driver for Red Bull and Toro Rosso.
Sainz drove for Scuderia Toro Rosso partnering Max Verstappen.
Sainz finished 15th in his first season with Toro Rosso.
Sainz moved to Renault beginning with the United States Grand Prix.
Sainz finished the season in 9th place.
Sainz finished the season in tenth place on 53 points.
Sainz moved to McLaren for the season.
Sainz earned his first podium in Formula One.
Sainz finished 6th place in the drivers championship.
Sainz finished the season in 6th place of the drivers championship.
Sainz joined Scuderia Ferrari.
Sainz took his third career podium and first with Ferrari at the Monaco Grand Prix.
